US Considers Ending 60-Day Grace Period for H-1B Visa Holders

The U.S. Department of Homeland Security is considering a proposal to end the 60-day grace period for foreign workers, including those on H-1B visas, after losing their jobs. This change would significantly reduce the time these individuals have to find new employment and maintain their immigration status in the U.S. The proposal is under review and could impact Indian workers who currently rely on this period to secure new jobs. Some reports indicate this is part of a broader review of immigration rules.
